facts.text: The hotel is the flagship hotel of Deer Valley East Village, near Park City.
facts.excerpt: As the flagship hotel of Deer Valley East Village, we are your basecamp for a grand adventure near Park City.

facts.text: The hotel offers slopeside access to skiing and easy access to Jordanelle Reservoir for fishing and paddleboarding.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy slopeside access to world-class skiing and effortless entry to Jordanelle Reservoir for fishing, paddleboarding and family fun.

facts.text: Rooms have a modern mountain style where contemporary design meets rustic charm.
facts.excerpt: Embrace modern mountain elegance, where contemporary design meets rustic charm.

facts.text: Rooms have large windows with views of Jordanelle Reservoir and the surrounding mountains.
facts.excerpt: our rooms offer large windows with exclusive breathtaking views of Jordanelle Reservoir and the surrounding mountains

facts.text: Room perks include fireplaces, kitchenettes and balcony views of Jordanelle Reservoir.
facts.excerpt: Lavish perks include fireplaces, kitchenettes and balcony views of Jordanelle Reservoir.

facts.text: The hotel's one-, two- and three-bedroom private residences have panoramic views of the Jordanelle Reservoir.
facts.excerpt: Our 1-, 2- or 3-bedroom private residences offer unparalleled panoramic views of the Jordanelle Reservoir while providing the comforting touches of home.

facts.text: Agaci Spa + Wellness is rooted in the restorative beauty of the Wasatch Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Rooted in the restorative beauty of the Wasatch Mountains, Agaci Spa + Wellness at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley is an elevated sanctuary designed for stillness, restoration and connection.

facts.text: The spa's signature Mountain Soul Ritual for couples features a foot soak, body polish and synchronized massage.
facts.excerpt: the signature Mountain Soul Ritual featuring a calming foot soak, body polish and synchronized massage

facts.text: The spa has the Ember Oasis dry heat sauna.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the comforting glow of embers, the Ember Oasis Sauna surrounds the body in soothing dry heat

facts.text: The heated outdoor pool and hot tubs are open year-round, surrounded by the alpine landscape.
facts.excerpt: year-round heated outdoor pool and hot tubs offer an inviting place to unwind surrounded by the alpine landscape

facts.text: On-site ski rentals with Ski Butlers include expert fittings, with rentals delivered to your room.
facts.excerpt: Our personalized rental service offers expert fittings and high-quality rentals straight to your room.

facts.text: The Nexus Lounge and Arcade has PS5 and Xbox gaming systems, air hockey, ping pong, vintage arcade games and board games.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy PS5 and Xbox gaming systems, air hockey, ping pong, vintage arcade games, board games, and puzzles

facts.text: Family activities include creative workshops, mountain stories, family movies, games and Saturday s'mores.
facts.excerpt: From creative workshops and mountain stories to family movies, games and Saturday s’mores, Grand Hyatt Deer Valley offers activities designed to bring families together throughout the week.

facts.text: High Chocolate in The Living Room is served by an oversized fireplace with live piano music and views of the snow-capped Uinta Mountains.
facts.excerpt: framed by the crackling warmth of our oversized, cozy fireplace, the soft melodies of live piano music, and breathtaking soaring views of the terrace and the snow-capped Uinta Mountains beyond

facts.text: Sushi by Scratch Restaurants brings Chef Phillip Frankland Lee's omakase experience to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Sushi by Scratch Restaurants brings Chef Phillip Frankland Lee’s signature omakase experience to Grand Hyatt Deer Valley in an unexpected and intimate setting.

facts.text: The meeting and event space has floor-to-ceiling windows and includes one of Park City's largest ballrooms.
facts.excerpt: features impressive floor-to-ceiling windows and includes one of Park City’s largest ballrooms

facts.text: Dogs are welcome at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Your dogs are welcome to come along for mountain adventures at our slopeside resort.

facts.text: There is a dedicated dog run on the property.
facts.excerpt: including a dedicated dog run on-property

facts.text: The hotel sits on the opposite side of the mountain from downtown Park City, overlooking the Jordanelle Reservoir.
facts.excerpt: the hotel is positioned on the opposite side of the mountain overlooking the Jordanelle Reservoir

facts.text: Downtown Park City is a 15 to 20 minute drive from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The always-fashionable downtown area of Park City is a 15-20 minute drive away

facts.text: Parking is valet only; self-parking is not available.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking only; self-parking is not available.

facts.text: The hotel is less than 45 minutes by car from Salt Lake City airport.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is located less than 45 minutes from Salt Lake City (SLC) Airport

facts.text: The hotel is the first hotel to open at Deer Valley's East Village ski base.
facts.excerpt: The Grand Hyatt Deer Valley is the first hotel to open at Deer Valley’s East Village ski base
